# MXToolbox

MxToolbox provides a suite of network diagnostic and monitoring tools, including DNS lookups, blacklist checks, and email health analysis.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mx-toolbox/.

## Actions

- **Check Usage** (read-only): Retrieve api usage statistics.
- **HTTP Lookup** (read-only): Perform an http test on a domain.
- **Lookup BIMI Record** (read-only): Retrieve bimi (brand indicators for message identification) record for a domain.
- **Lookup Blacklist** (read-only): Perform a blacklist check on a domain or ip.
- **Lookup DKIM Record** (read-only): Retrieve dkim records for a domain.
- **Lookup DMARC Record** (read-only): Retrieve dmarc records for a domain.
- **Lookup DNS Records** (read-only): Retrieve dns records for a given domain.
- **Lookup MTA-STS Record** (read-only): Lookup mta-sts record for a domain.
- **Lookup MX Records** (read-only): Retrieve mx records for a given domain.
- **Lookup SPF Record** (read-only): Retrieve spf records for a specified domain.
- **Monitor Status** (read-only): Retrieve all monitor statuses.
- **Ping Lookup** (read-only): Perform a ping test on a specified domain or ip address.
- **SMTP Lookup** (read-only): Perform an smtp test on the specified domain.
